blocks.text: I can use ‘c’est’ to identify things when I speak and write.
I know to pronounce the ‘t’ in ‘c’est’ when it comes before ‘un’ or ‘une’.
Tap each word to see what it means.

items.def: Two words, ce (c’) and est, meaning ‘it is’ or ‘it’s’ in French.
Pronouncing a usually silent final consonant because a word starting with a vowel follows.
A silent letter at the end of a word.

blocks.label: What is the last letter of c’est?
blocks.text: The ‘t’. In c’est the ‘t’ is normally a silent final consonant (SFC), so you do not say it.
We can use c’est with a noun to say what something is. After c’est use {une} for a feminine noun and {un} for a masculine noun.
Remember to use the correct indefinite article!

blocks.q: Which is the correct way to say ‘It’s a bag’?
blocks.why: Use c’est for ‘it’s’ and un before the masculine noun sac.

blocks.q: Which is the correct way to say ‘It’s a bottle’?
blocks.why: Bouteille is feminine, so we use une after c’est.

blocks.q: Choose un or une to finish each sentence.

blocks.text: You can use c’est to answer a question about what something is.

items: C’est un cahier ? Oui, c’est un cahier.
C’est un sac ? Non, c’est un ballon.
C’est un stylo ? Non, c’est un cahier.

blocks.label: Did you see a capital letter?
blocks.text: In French, the days of the week do not start with a capital letter: c’est lundi, non, c’est vendredi.
The ‘t’ in c’est is normally a silent final consonant.
However, the ‘t’ is pronounced when the next word starts with a vowel sound. This is called {liaison}.
Liaison means ‘link’ in French, and it helps you sound more French!
You pronounce the ‘t’ in c’est if the next word starts with a vowel. Un and une start with a vowel (u).

blocks.label: What do you notice?
blocks.text: After c’est, un and une start with a vowel, so the ‘t’ is pronounced. Lundi and drôle start with a consonant, so the ‘t’ is silent.

blocks.q: When do you pronounce the ‘t’ in ‘c’est’?
options: When the next word starts with a vowel
blocks.why: The usually silent ‘t’ is pronounced when a word starting with a vowel follows. This is liaison.

blocks.q: Which of these do you say WITHOUT the ‘t’ sound in c’est?
blocks.why: Lundi starts with a consonant, so the ‘t’ stays silent.

blocks.q: Sort the sentences: do you say the ‘t’ of c’est?
Match the French to the English.

items: C’est means ‘it is’ or ‘it’s’ in French.
It can be used with any singular noun to say what something is: c’est un stylo, c’est une peluche.
Normally the ‘t’ in c’est is a silent final consonant.
When c’est is followed by a word that starts with a vowel sound, like un or une, the ‘t’ is pronounced.
This is called liaison, and it is important for correct pronunciation in French.

worksheet.title: Worksheet: What is it? C’est and liaison
worksheet.instructions: Answer with one word or a short phrase. Remember: un goes before masculine nouns and une before feminine nouns.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap with un or une: C’est ___ peluche.
questions.explanation: Peluche is feminine, so we use une.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap with un or une: C’est ___ stylo.
questions.explanation: Stylo is masculine, so we use un.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap with un or une: C’est ___ jeu.
questions.explanation: Jeu is masculine, so we use un.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap with un or une: C’est ___ ballon.
questions.explanation: Ballon is masculine, so we use un.

questions.prompt: Write the French for ‘It’s an exercise book.’
questions.explanation: C’est means it’s and cahier is masculine, so we use un.

questions.prompt: Write the French for ‘It’s a bottle.’
questions.explanation: C’est means it’s and bouteille is feminine, so we use une.

questions.prompt: Which letter of ‘c’est’ is normally a silent final consonant?
questions.explanation: The ‘t’ at the end of c’est is normally not pronounced.

questions.prompt: What is the word for pronouncing a usually silent final consonant because a word starting with a vowel follows?
Do you pronounce the ‘t’ in “C’est lundi.”? Answer yes or no.
questions.explanation: Lundi starts with a consonant, so the ‘t’ stays silent.

questions.prompt: Do you pronounce the ‘t’ in “C’est une orange.”? Answer yes or no.
questions.explanation: Une starts with a vowel, so the ‘t’ is pronounced: liaison.
